title: Container structure type
description: Kind of represented container, independent of its naming profile.

oneOf.title: Object
oneOf.description: A general data object or document container.

oneOf.title: Class
oneOf.description: A concrete or abstract class declaration.

oneOf.title: Interface
oneOf.description: An interface declaration defining a contract.

oneOf.title: Enumeration
oneOf.description: An enumeration type containing a fixed set of values.

oneOf.title: Annotation
oneOf.description: An annotation type used to attach metadata.

oneOf.title: Resource bundle
oneOf.description: A resource bundle containing localized text or other resources.
